enabled.title: Extract attachments
enabled.description: Off by default. When on, the component also creates the table confluence_attachments with metadata of the attachments of every extracted page.

download_files.title: Download the files
download_files.description: When on, the component also saves the attachment files (images, PDFs and other binaries) to Keboola File Storage, tagged confluence-attachment. The column file_name links a table row to its file.

max_file_size_mb.title: Maximum file size (MB)
max_file_size_mb.description: The component does not download a file larger than this. Its metadata stays in the table. Use 0 for no limit.

media_types.title: Media type filter
media_types.description: Optional. A comma separated list of media type prefixes, for example image/, application/pdf. Only matching files are downloaded; the table always holds every attachment. Empty means all files.
